clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the fear of losing money is never really about the money - it only shows up once the money is real.

He uses a day trader as the example: paper trading, no fear, steady wins. Fund the account with real cash, and the same person freezes, hesitates, loses.

The difference isn't skill. It's a fear that wasn't there until there was something real to lose.

Comment BRAIN and I'll send you the training Kevin built for talking to your own mind the right way, straight to your messages.

What do you freeze up on the moment it gets real?
